notes: Added missing schema, API, rotation scheduling, and audit coverage for token lifecycle.

change_log.note: Adds external control surface for rotation

stories.title: Token Schema & Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the token persistence schema including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotated_from, revoked_at, and scope. Ensure compatibility with existing MongoDB utilities and enforce secure hashing of tokens at rest.

stories.title: Token Rotation API
stories.description: Implement a secure API endpoint to rotate bearer tokens, issuing a new token while linking it to the prior token via rotated_from and invalidating reuse of the old token after rotation.

stories.title: Automated Expiration & Rotation Scheduler
stories.description: Implement a background process or scheduled job that enforces token expiration and optionally triggers rotation policies (e.g., max lifetime), ensuring expired tokens are unusable without requiring request-time checks alone.

stories.title: Token Audit Logging & Traceability
stories.description: Extend audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, expiration, revocation, and authentication failures. Ensure logs are queryable for security reviews and incident analysis.

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict validation and reuse existing auth patterns to reduce implementation errors
